newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 opens firmer, rebound seen limited.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 opens firmer, rebound seen limited.

text.p: The UK's leading FTSE 100 share index opened firmer on Monday, but dealers said they did not expect the market to make much progress ahead of the Federal Open Market Committee meeting on Tuesday, when many expect a U.S. interest rate rise.
"Whilst this is nothing new -- and I think it's pretty well priced into the market -- I think people are focusing on the chance of more rate increases and a rate increase here," said one dealer.
At 0838 GMT, the blue chip index was up 7.4 points to 4,262.2, after ex-dividend share prices sliced off four points.
